Monday 26 Oct

Garlic Butter Salmon with Creamy Mashed Potato and Green Peas

Fish30 minFamily friendly

Ingredients

Salmon
  • Skin-on salmon fillet440 g
  • Garlic4 cloves
  • Lemon1
  • Vegetable oil1¼ tbsp
  • Salt½ tsp
  • Butter40 g
Mashed potato
  • Potatoes750 g
  • Cream cheese100 g
  • Salt½ tsp
  • Black pepper½ tsp
Peas
  • Green peas190 g
  • Salt½ tsp
  • Black pepper½ tsp

Method

  1. Make mash. Peel and chop the potatoes and boil in salted water over medium heat for 20 min until soft. Drain, return to the pan with the cream cheese, mash until smooth and season. Cover.
  2. Prep. Finely chop the garlic. Cut the lemon into wedges. Portion the salmon.
  3. Fry salmon. Salt the skin. Fry skin-side down in a little oil over medium-high heat for 3–4 min, flip and cook 3–4 min more until cooked through. Move to a plate; pour off excess oil and keep the pan.
  4. Make garlic butter. Melt the butter in the pan over medium heat, add the garlic and cook 1 min. Take off the heat.
  5. Cook peas. Boil in salted water for 1 min, drain and season. Cover to keep warm.
  6. Serve. Return the salmon to the garlic butter, skin up, with a squeeze of lemon. Serve with the mash and peas, the lemon wedges and the garlic butter.

Tuesday 27 Oct

Eggplant Parmigiana with Garlic Ciabatta

Vegetarian45 min

Ingredients

Parmigiana
  • Eggplant1½
  • Olive oil2½ tbsp
  • Salt½ tsp
  • Garlic4 cloves
  • Parmesan40 g
  • Red onion1
  • Dried oregano2 g (about 1½ tsp)
  • Tomato paste40 g (2¾ tbsp)
  • Water250 ml (about 1 cup)
  • Chopped tomatoes330 g
  • Red wine vinegar18 ml (1¼ tbsp)
  • Vegetable stock cube1
  • Brown sugar4 g (1 tsp)
  • Grated mozzarella170 g
  • Fresh basil13 g
Garlic bread
  • Fresh parsley13 g
  • Butter40 g
  • Ciabatta2

Method

  1. Bake eggplants. Preheat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Slice the eggplants into 1 cm rounds, lay on a lined tray, drizzle generously with olive oil and season with salt. Roast 20–25 min.
  2. Prep. Mince the garlic, grate the Parmesan, finely chop the red onion.
  3. Simmer. Fry the onion in olive oil with a pinch of salt for 5 min. Add half the garlic and the oregano for 1 min. Add the tomato paste, water, chopped tomatoes, vinegar, stock cube and sugar; simmer 10 min. Keep the rest of the garlic for the garlic butter.
  4. Bake parmigiana. Layer half the eggplant in a baking dish, cover with half the sauce and half the mozzarella. Repeat. Top with the Parmesan and bake 20 min until golden.
  5. Bake garlic bread. Chop the parsley and mash it into the butter with the remaining garlic. Halve the ciabatta, spread with the garlic butter and bake 10 min until crisp.
  6. Serve. Let the parmigiana cool for 5 min, garnish with basil and serve with the garlic ciabatta.

Wednesday 28 Oct

Brown Butter Steak with Crisp Broccoli and Chimichurri

Red meat20 minUses shop 2

Ingredients

Steak
  • Rump steak500 g
  • Vegetable oil1¼ tbsp
  • Salt½ tsp
  • Butter65 g
Broccoli
  • Broccoli500 g
  • Water65 ml (about ¼ cup)
  • Salt½ tsp
  • Vegetable oil1¼ tbsp
Chimichurri
  • Small red chilli1
  • Fresh coriander19 g
  • Fresh parsley19 g
  • Garlic powder3 g (1¼ tsp)
  • Salt½ tsp
  • Olive oil2½ tbsp
  • Red wine vinegar19 ml (1¼ tbsp)
  • Dried oregano3 g (about 2¼ tsp)

Method

  1. Prep chimichurri. Finely chop the chilli (spicy), coriander and parsley, stalks included. Mix in a bowl with 1 tbsp water, the garlic powder, a pinch of salt, the olive oil, vinegar and oregano.
  2. Fry steak. Pat the steaks dry, rub with oil and season with salt. Fry in a very hot pan for 3–5 min each side, or to your liking. Rest on a plate. Wipe the pan and keep it.
  3. Fry broccoli. Cut into florets. Heat the pan with the water and a pinch of salt; when boiling, add the broccoli, cover and cook 3 min. Uncover and cook 1 min until the water has gone, then add a drizzle of oil and fry 1–2 min until lightly browned. Wipe the pan.
  4. Make brown butter. Heat the pan high, add the butter and stir continuously. When it starts to brown, lower to medium; once browned, take off the heat.
  5. Serve the rested steaks with the broccoli and chimichurri, drizzled with the brown butter.

For faster chimichurri, blitz everything in a blender. Resting the steak keeps it tender.

Thursday 29 Oct

Hunter's Chicken with Roasted Potatoes and Peas

Chicken50 minKid-friendly

Ingredients

Chicken
  • Chicken breast500 g
  • Beef bacon110 g
  • Black pepper½ tsp
  • Barbecue sauce100 g (about 6 tbsp)
  • Grated mozzarella110 g
Potatoes
  • Potatoes630 g
  • Vegetable oil1¼ tbsp
  • Salt¼ tsp
  • Black pepper½ tsp
  • Dried thyme3 g (about 2¼ tsp)
Peas
  • Butter13 g
  • Green peas250 g
  • Salt¼ tsp
  • Black pepper½ tsp

Method

  1. Prep. Preheat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Cut the potatoes (skin on) into bite-sized pieces. Wrap each chicken breast in bacon.
  2. Bake. Put the potatoes and chicken on a lined tray. Drizzle the potatoes with oil and season with salt, pepper and thyme; season the chicken with pepper. Bake 20–25 min until cooked. Move the potatoes to a plate and leave the chicken on the tray.
  3. Top chicken. Switch the oven to grill. Pour the BBQ sauce over the chicken, sprinkle with mozzarella and grill 3–5 min until golden and bubbling.
  4. Cook peas. Melt the butter in a pan over medium-high heat, add the peas and fry 3–5 min. Season.
  5. Serve the chicken with the roast potatoes and peas.

For kids: keep some chicken plain (bacon cooked on the side, BBQ sauce on the side) and take out some peas before adding pepper. For extra crispy potatoes, use a separate tray.

Friday 30 Oct

Ready-made Lasagna with Crispy Lettuce Side Salad

Pastaheat per pack

We buy the lasagna ready-made (family size, on shop 2). Heat it as the pack says and make only the salad.

Ingredients

Salad
  • Ready-made lasagna1 family size
  • Bionda lettuce130 g
  • Olive oil2½ tbsp
  • Balsamic vinegar19 ml (1¼ tbsp)
  • Salt and black pepperto taste

Method

  1. Heat the lasagna following the pack instructions.
  2. Prep salad. Wash and dry the lettuce. Whisk the balsamic and olive oil with salt and pepper.
  3. Serve. Dress the lettuce just before serving, alongside the lasagna.
